job: Adapt supplied camera detections and manual corners into the existing calibrate callbacks, collect failures and map supplied points through toFrame
job_scope: Only the supplied-input row adapter: convert detected/manual values into callbacks, collect reports and map requested points by calling the existing calibration exports. No claim of new projective-calibration, coordinate-transform or confidence-fallback algorithms.
preserve: Delegate calibration and point transforms to src/frame-calibration.mjs
Return automatic/manual source, observed confidence and every collected failure
Preserve needs_manual and invalid-corner refusal behavior
allowed_deltas: The original row invocation seam only; current runtime and descriptor bytes remain unchanged.
banned_substitutions: Claiming calibration had no older owner
Reimplementing homography, coordinate transforms or fallback logic in the adapter

baseline.scope: No source-copy baseline is claimed for this newly authored invocation adapter.

authorship.scope: This wrapper was authored alongside its descriptor and tests. Its current bytes still match that introduction; the existing algorithm was a separate dependency.

distinct_from.why: The existing frame-calibration algorithm owns homography solving, coordinate mapping and automatic/manual confidence fallback. The adapter invokes it and does not assert that calibration has no older owner.
Earlier calibration tests call the projective-map and calibration owner; tests are not the supplied-input row adapter.
The preserved frame-calibration implementation owns the projective map, confidence fallback and point transform. This wrapper supplies callbacks from row input and calls those existing exports.
Synthetic direct and packaged tests exercise the wrapper and existing algorithm; they are consumers, not independent implementations.
Documents the same wrapper and its algorithm dependency; documentation is not an earlier implementation.
Invocation DATA names this exact wrapper and packs its existing algorithm dependency; it is a caller declaration rather than another implementation.
Published invocation DATA describes the same camera row and input shape; it is not another callback or calibration implementation.

underlying_owner_boundary.scope: The original algorithm remains present at the checked main commit. This wrapper contract neither claims its retirement nor qualifies a source-first migration of that algorithm.
